# theme-zoom

<!-- okfreq:index:start -->
<!-- Generated by okfreq lint; edit requirement metadata instead. -->

- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-THEME-002 — A reader chooses a preview theme that paints the whole page readably](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-THEME-002.md) — When the reader presses the Theme button, the Studio SHALL switch the preview to the next theme mode of Current, Dark, White and Cream, show which mode is active and which comes next, and paint the whole page in the colours of that mode.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-THEME-004 — The theme choice holds for the workspace and survives slow loads and bad values](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-THEME-004.md) — When the reader picks a theme mode, the Studio SHALL remember it for the workspace and use it the next time the preview opens, show Cream in a workspace where no theme was ever chosen, give a page that finishes loading late the colours of the current VS Code theme, and ignore a stored or received value that is not a known theme mode.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-THEME-011 — A reader zooms the text and the column and keeps the zoom](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-THEME-011.md) — When the reader presses Zoom in or Zoom out, the Studio SHALL scale the text and the content column together between 70 % and 200 % in steps of 10 points, keep the reading position, and remember the zoom for the workspace and for the panel.

<!-- okfreq:index:end -->
